While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

bindings.title: Select the Google Sheets documentId
bindings.detail: The dropdown shows "Asset Tracker", which is a placeholder label with no value behind it - the node looks configured and is not. Open each of: Load Previous Snapshot, Load Rows into Google Sheets, Park in Dead-Letter Queue, Quarantine Bad Rows and pick the real documentId from the list.
